run_tacred_training: run BERT training on the TACRED relation extraction dataset with configurable hyperparameters
evaluate_tacred_model: evaluate a trained BERT model on the TACRED dev or test set and compute F1 and accuracy metrics
convert_examples_to_features: convert TACRED input examples to BERT input features with special span and NER tokens
process_tacred_dataset: load and process TACRED JSON dataset into training, dev, and test examples with label mapping
compute_f1_metrics: compute precision, recall, and F1 score for relation extraction predictions excluding no_relation class
